answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies, forcing an attacker to provide unique physical data to register each node. By elevating the entry cost to the nadir of biological uniqueness, the protocol thwarts mass-generated identities. Like a falcon tracking prey, the consensus layer algorithmically monitors identity drift, ensuring that the computational cost of forging credentials remains prohibitively expensive relative to the expected protocol reward.
